purpose: Real-music local inference smoke check, not an accuracy evaluation
sample: First 30 seconds of Vibe Ace by Kevin MacLeod

neural_result.model: MTG MSD MusiCNN + mood heads + genre Dortmund
warnings: Experimental music estimates: model scores are not calibrated confidence or ground truth.
Mood attributes are independent and may overlap; 0.5 is the binary decision threshold.
Genre is selected from nine training classes; speech, noise and missing genres can still receive a label.

limitations: Independent mood scores are not calibrated confidence.
Nine-class genre model omits styles including classical.
NumPy/librosa preprocessing port is not claimed bit-identical to Essentia on all platforms.
